usage: 教学用结构重建。均非官方论文图；来源已由研究代理核验，生成结果逐图检查，并按 root 独立审查意见修订。

legend.solid: 已披露模块或支持的系统数据流
legend.gray_dashed: 仅图中文字明确指出的未披露内部机制；辅助/训练面板边界需按逐图标题判断
legend.separate_panel: 训练说明、辅助神经模块或系统工作流，性质见逐图注释

prompt_history_note: initial_prompt 为最初生成指令，revision_prompts 按顺序修正其问题；以最终PNG及最终审查条目为准，不将已修正的早期prompt内容当成现行事实。

figures.provenance: Public-source architecture reconstruction; not an official diagram.
figures.initial_prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: accurate model architecture figure for a Chinese multimodal LLM tutorial, English labels.
Primary request: Create a polished scholarly architecture diagram on a clean white background, landscape 3:2, high resolution. Title exactly "Qwen3.5 architecture reconstruction". Subtitle "397B-A17B checkpoint".
Diagram content: Two inputs at left: Image / Video (blue) and Text (cream). Image/video enters a blue box "Vision encoder" with compact labels "27 layers; patch 16; temporal patch 2". Then a blue box "Spatial merger" with labels "2 x 2; output dim 4096". Text enters cream box "Token embeddings". Both streams join a sequence of visual tokens and text tokens and flow into a large pale green box labelled "Hybrid MoE decoder: 60 layers". Inside show a vertical ordered block of three blue-green "Gated DeltaNet" layers then one lavender "Gated Attention" layer, with brackets "repeat 15 times". A parallel side box attached to the decoder says "MoE per layer" with "512 routed experts; top-10 + shared expert". Show arrows through all layers, no arrow across unconnected alternatives. Decoder flows to orange "Text / Code output". Small bottom annotation "Interleaved MRoPE; native context 262,144 tokens". Optional bottom training strip separate from inference path: "Early text-vision fusion" → "Large-scale RL", with no invented dataset count.
Typography: crisp professional sans serif, all exact model numbers legible, simple rectangular blocks, thin arrows, restrained pastel blue/green/lavender/orange, no photographic decoration. Footer exactly "Reconstructed from public sources; not an official diagram". Bottom legend "Solid: disclosed modules and flow".
Constraints: No DeepStack branches, no audio encoder, no pixel generation head. Do not imply all variants have this exact number of experts/layers. Do not add any unknown module, fabricated benchmark or logo. Leave generous whitespace and use at most 20 text labels.
revision_prompts: Use case: precise-object-edit. In this inspected Qwen3.5 diagram, change only the heading of the lower training panel. Replace "Optional training (not part of inference path)" by the exact text "High-level training (not part of inference path)". Preserve everything else exactly, including the two training blocks and arrows, all model counts/experts, upper inference path, context length, title/subtitle, footer, palette and image dimensions.

checks: 397B-A17B checkpoint stated; vision 27 layers, patch16/temporal2/2x2 merger shown.
60-layer hybrid decoder rendered as 3 DeltaNet + 1 gated full-attention x15; 512 routed experts top10+shared.
High-level early text-vision fusion and large-scale RL are distinct from inference; no DeepStack assumed.
